A '''wooden hoe''' is a [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]] of the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] tier, crafted from two planks and two sticks. The pack's README recommends it as one of the first tools: with a [[Kindling|campfire]], it starts the path to [[food]] and the [[mud kiln]].

== Usage ==

=== Farming ===
It tills soil and breaks hoe blocks at the vanilla speed of 2, with {{Value|Wooden Hoe|durability}} durability (vanilla: 59). Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref> Breaking short grass with a hoe has a 12.5% chance to drop wheat seeds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/short_grass.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Wooden Hoe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Wooden Hoe|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with planks. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
